Liposarcoma: 7-year history of a submucosal tumour below the esophagogastric junction
Presented in November 2011 with melena and progressive anemia
Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen revealed a 70 × 50 × 55 mm hypoechogenic, subcardial mass on the posterior gastric wall
Six weeks later, endoscopic evaluation demonstrated a recurrent bleeding tumour at the same site
